title: Fourier Spectral Reciprocity and Canonical Hecke $L$-Functions
summary: We prove a Fourier-type toric spectral reciprocity formula over number fields, relating Tate integrals over a quadratic extension to a dual family of Hecke periods over the base field. The formula keeps the spectral parameter free and allows test functions adapted to arithmetic applications. We apply this reciprocity formula to canonical Hecke $L$-functions over CM fields and obtain explicit first moment formulas, including both central values and central derivatives. These formulas are uniform in the weight and the twisting conductor, and require no Heegner-type splitting hypothesis.…
